verdict.rationale: Bolna offers no-code agent setup: Agent Studio builds a call-ready agent from a plain description, dashboard tabs let you configure the agent and add tools with a click, and templates can be cloned and customized. However, its multi-step workflows (calls, WhatsApp, waits, retries) are described as "driven entirely through the Bolna API", so that part requires code rather than a visual canvas. Missing for 10: a visual flow/canvas builder, no-code branching logic, explicit state management, documented human/agent handoff design in a UI, and independent hands-on corroboration.
